svg.text: Freshroots Replenishment Loop — MVP Components Map v3 (simplified)
Human gate: code recommends, Raghav approves, procurement places every order.
Nothing reaches a supplier without a person.
AI never sets quantities or places orders
Off-map: one-off 3-year replay script (day-45 gate). Design rule: code decides quantities; Claude explains; people approve and issue; success = fewer stockouts and write-offs than the manual SKUs.
